description: Fattore di amplificazione sismica calcolato is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datigis.comune.fi.it. Calculated seismic amplification factor(from the Civil Protection Department site)Seismic Amplification Factor: Increase in the amplitude of the seismic signal compared to a hypothetical base rock (bedrock), within some frequency ranges, to the propagation of waves across different terrains.Note Amplifaction Factor: 1.7 SIGNIFICATIVE. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Calculated seismic amplification factor" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include fattore, ambiente, piano strutturale, sismica, pericolosità, pericolo. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
